title: Uniqueness results for quasi-analytic functions on compact Lie groups and homogeneous spaces
summary: In this article, we establish a quantitative uniqueness theorem for quasi-analytic functions defined on compact, connected Lie groups $G$ and on homogeneous spaces $G/H$, where $H$ is any closed subgroup of $G$. Our result extends classical Logvinenko-Sereda-type theorems to the setting of quasi-analytic functions on compact Lie groups and their homogeneous spaces. We introduce the quasi-analytic class of functions using iterates of the Casimir operator on $G$. This construction is justified by establishing that every function in this class possesses the strong unique continuation property.…
